cues.en: So let's make all this talk concrete and run some real code to perform user-based collaborative filtering on the MovieLens dataset.
cues.zh: 來把這些討論具體化，執行真正的程式碼，對 MovieLens 資料集做使用者式協同過濾。

cues.en: Open up Spyder,
cues.zh: 開啟 Spyder，

cues.en: and close out any old stuff we don't need any more.
cues.zh: 關閉不再需要的舊檔案。

cues.en: Now open up the collaborative filtering folder in our course materials.
cues.zh: 開啟課程教材中的 CollaborativeFiltering 資料夾。

cues.en: And load up everything in there.
cues.zh: 載入裡面的所有檔案。

cues.en: The file we're interested in right now is SimpleUserCf.py, so click on that tab and let's walk through it.
cues.zh: 目前關注的是 SimpleUserCF.py，按它的分頁，一起看一遍。

cues.en: It's surprisingly small, right?
cues.zh: 程式短得令人驚訝，對吧？

cues.en: Oh see what I did there, surprisingly?
cues.zh: 有發現嗎？Surprise，令人驚訝。

cues.en: It's because we're using the Surprise library to do a lot of the heavy lifting here.
cues.zh: 因為用了 Surprise 函式庫，替我們處理很多繁重工作。

cues.en: So this script just walks through the steps we talked about in the slides.
cues.zh: 因此，這個指令碼只是走過投影片中談到的步驟。

cues.en: It's not really integrated into the evaluation framework we developed earlier, because user-based collaborative filtering, as we've described, is strictly for generating top N recommendations.
cues.zh: 它沒有真正整合到先前開發的評估框架，因為剛才描述的使用者式協同過濾，只用來產生 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: And no point did we attempt to predict user raters, so we can't really shoehorn this algorithm into the Surprise framework, because it revolves around making rating predictions.
cues.zh: 我們從來沒有試著預測使用者評分，因此無法硬塞進以評分預測為核心的 Surprise 框架。

cues.en: That's okay, we'll get back to our framework really soon, and we're going to still use some of the components of surprise.
cues.zh: 沒關係，很快會回到框架，也仍會使用 Surprise 的一些元件。

cues.en: Step one was to load up our data, and that's the first thing this script does, loads up the MovieLens rating dataset and builds up a complete training set.
cues.zh: 第一步是載入資料，指令碼首先就載入 MovieLens 評分資料集，建立完整訓練集。

cues.en: We don't need to split out a test set since again, we're not measuring accuracy here, we're just making top N recommendations and seeing what they look like.
cues.zh: 不需要切出測試集，因為再次強調，這裡不衡量準確程度，只產生 Top-N 推薦，看看結果。

cues.en: The next chunk of code builds up the similarity matrix between every possible user pair.
cues.zh: 下一段程式碼，建立每對可能使用者的相似度矩陣。

cues.en: To do this quickly and easily, we're using Surpriselib's KNNBasic algorithm, which is part of what it does, builds up a similarity matrix that we can use instead for our own purposes.
cues.zh: 為了快速輕鬆地完成，使用 SurpriseLib 的 KNNBasic 演算法；它的工作之一，就是建立相似度矩陣，我們可以取來作自己的用途。

cues.en: Pay particular attention to the sim options parameter here.
cues.zh: 特別注意這裡的 sim_options 參數。

cues.en: We're specifying that we want to use cosine for our similarity metric.
cues.zh: 我們指定使用 cosine 作為相似度指標。

cues.en: You could also specify MSD or Pearson here, and Surpriselib would do just that for you.
cues.zh: 這裡也可以指定 MSD 或 Pearson，SurpriseLib 就會替你使用那些指標。

cues.en: We're also specifying that we want user-based similarities, so we get a matrix mapping user to user similarity scores.
cues.zh: 也指定要使用使用者式相似度，因此取得的是使用者對使用者相似度矩陣。

cues.en: Then we just tell Surpriselib to go and build that user similarity matrix and hang onto a copy of it for ourselves.
cues.zh: 接著，只要叫 SurpriseLib 建立使用者相似度矩陣，再替自己保留一份。

cues.en: Next on lines 33 to 34, we extract all the similar users to our test user, user number 85, who we will grow to know and love, we then convert that to a list of tuples
cues.zh: 接著在第 33、34 行，擷取與測試使用者 85 相似的所有使用者。我們會逐漸熟悉並喜愛這位使用者，再將結果轉成 tuple 串列，

cues.en: containing the inner user IDs and user similarity scores to user 85, being careful to skip over the similarity to ourself, as that's not useful data.
cues.zh: 包含內部使用者 ID，以及與使用者 85 的相似度，並小心略過與自己的相似度，因為那不是有用資料。

cues.en: We then use the heapq.nlargest function to quickly sort all of the users by their similarity to user 85 and pluck off the top K results to get our neighborhood of similar users.
cues.zh: 再用 heapq.nlargest，快速依與使用者 85 的相似度排序所有使用者，取出前 k 個，形成相似使用者的鄰域。

cues.en: Next, we build up our list of recommendation candidates by extracting everything the similar users rated, and as we go, we score them based on their ratings by the similar users, and by their similarity to our user.
cues.zh: 接著，取出相似使用者評分過的所有東西，建立推薦候選清單，同時根據相似使用者的評分，以及與目標使用者的相似度，替它們計分。

cues.en: One thing that's worth calling out is that we're actually adding in the score for a given movie if we encounter it more than once, giving more weight to items that more than one similar user rated.
cues.zh: 值得特別指出的是，遇到同一部電影不只一次時，會繼續加總分數，讓多位相似使用者評分過的項目，得到更高權重。

cues.en: Our use of Python's defaultdict is how we ensure we get a default value of zero for each item to start with.
cues.zh: 使用 Python 的 defaultdict，確保每個項目一開始的預設值是零。

cues.en: Next we build up a dictionary for use in the final filtering state, so we can quickly look up whether our recommendation has already been rated by the user.
cues.zh: 接著建立字典，供最後過濾階段使用，快速查詢使用者是否已評分過某個推薦。

cues.en: The last step is to sort the recommendation candidates by their final scores, and go through the top N of those, skipping over results that we've already watched.
cues.zh: 最後，依最終分數排序候選項目，逐一處理前 N 個，略過已經看過的結果。

cues.en: And as we go, we look up the movie names and print them out in a human-readable format.
cues.zh: 同時查詢電影名稱，以人類易讀的格式印出。

cues.en: So let's run it and see what happens.
cues.zh: 執行看看。

cues.en: Whoa, that was really quick, right?
cues.zh: 哇，非常快，對吧？

cues.en: It's because we didn't have to predict the rating for every possible item by every possible user as part of trying to measure accuracy.
cues.zh: 因為不用為了衡量準確程度，預測每位使用者對每個可能項目的評分。

cues.en: The only time consuming part here is building up that user-to-user similarity matrix, and after that, making recommendations for individuals is really, really fast.
cues.zh: 這裡唯一耗時的部分，是建立使用者間的相似度矩陣；完成後，為個人推薦非常非常快。

cues.en: That's why collaborative filtering is something big companies like Amazon can use easily with their massive dataset and massive transaction rates.
cues.zh: 因此，Amazon 這類大公司，能輕鬆將協同過濾用在龐大資料集與大量交易上。

cues.en: Efficiency matters as much as anything in these sorts of large scale settings.
cues.zh: 在這種大規模情境中，效率與其他事情同樣重要。

cues.en: And the results look really exciting, too.
cues.zh: 結果看起來也很令人興奮。

cues.en: I chose user 85 because his or her rating profile seemed similar to my own interests and every single one of the movies recommended here are ones that I have both seen, and enjoyed.
cues.zh: 我選擇使用者 85，是因為他的評分輪廓似乎與我的興趣相近；而這裡推薦的每一部電影，我都看過，也都很喜歡。

cues.en: Even though 100 thousand ratings is considered relatively sparse, we still ended up with some very promising results, much better than what we saw when using content attributes alone.
cues.zh: 即使十萬筆評分仍算相對稀疏，我們仍得到相當有潛力的結果，比只用內容屬性時好得多。

cues.en: So finally, we're getting some results that we can really be happy about here.
cues.zh: 所以，終於出現真正讓人滿意的結果。

cues.en: You could probably stop taking this course right now and have what you need to make a successful, real-world system.
cues.zh: 你或許現在停止上課，就已經具備建立成功實務系統所需的東西。

cues.en: But we want to squeeze every dollar we can out of our Recommender system and there are a few more tricks to show you on how to make the results even better, so stick with me here.
cues.zh: 但我們想讓推薦系統創造盡可能多的收益，還有一些技巧能讓結果更好，所以繼續跟著我。
